title: Saturday 050604
wodRaw:
**“Cindy”**  
  
Complete as many rounds in 20 minutes as you can of:   
5 Pull-ups   
10 Push-ups  
15 Squats  
  
OR  
  
**“Mary”**  
  
Complete as many rounds in 20 minutes as you can of:   
5 Handstand Push-ups  
10 One legged squats, alternating  
15 Pull-ups  
  
Cindy is Chelsea’s less patient twin sister. Post your choice of girls and rounds completed to comments.  
  
Compare to [050514](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/000785.html).
otherRaw:
“Military PT tests traditionally include timed pull-ups, push-ups, sit-ups, and running as distinct test elements. If instead, the separate test elements were combined into a single timed effort, the original test and sought after capacity would be preserved while simultaneously a new broader capacity would be encouraged and developed.”   
  
 - Greg Glassman

otherRaw: Focused education, dedicated training, and long term practice of breakfall techniques is critical for many CrossFitters. Falls and stumbles from seemingly insignificant heights take an unnecessary toll. Here is an excellent introduction to the subject of breakfalling from the U.S. Navy in 1943: [http://www.crossfit.com/cf-journal/Gymnastics_tumbling/Falling.pdf](http://www.crossfit.com/cf-journal/Gymnastics_tumbling/Falling.pdf)

wodRaw:
